howto.name: Upload PDF(s)
howto.text: Drop one or many PDFs up to 500 MB each. Multi-file batches are supported.

howto.name: PrivaTools removes all metadata
howto.text: Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Producer, Creator, Creation Date, Modified Date, all XMP fields, and any custom-defined metadata.

howto.name: Download the clean PDF (or ZIP)
howto.text: Single file → single PDF; multiple files → ZIP. Visible content is unchanged.

faq.a: Author / producer / original-filename fields can identify who created or owns a document — a privacy concern for whistleblowers, journalists, or before public release.
Image-level EXIF inside PDF embedded images is also stripped. The image pixel data is unchanged.

faq.q: Is this the same as Sanitize?
faq.a: No — Strip Metadata removes informational fields. Sanitize removes security-risky elements (JavaScript, auto-launch attachments).
